recentItems.title: Ukraine's RK 2PZ and KORAL from TANK KILLER to BALLISTIC INTERCEPTOR
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian long-range drones set fire to a fuel terminal in Russia's Novorossiysk: fuel storage tanks were damaged, disrupting fuel supplies for Russian troops and the Black Sea Fleet.
At the same time, Ukraine's defense industry brought the new RK-2PZ surface-to-air missile to the battlefield — the system has successfully passed its first combat trials and will now be used to destroy enemy drones en masse, saving scarce Western interceptors.
The outcomes of the Ramstein meeting cemented this success: allies agreed on new large aid packages including major batches of air-defense missiles, thousands of drones, and critically important artillery ammunition for the Armed Forces of Ukraine!

recentItems.title: RUSSIA LOSSES $1 BILLION IN 6 DAYS! MiG 29, Ka 27, airfields & three AIR DEFENCES obliterated!
recentItems.description:
Between September 2 and September 7, Russia suffered a staggering $1.08 billion in military and infrastructural losses from relentless Ukrainian precision strikes.

In just five days, Moscow lost a MiG-29 jet, a Ka-27 helicopter, the vessel Nefrit in the port of Sochi, three air defense systems in a single day, plus sustained heavy damage to the Ryazan refinery and the airfield at Rostov-on-Don.

In this edition of Russian Losses, Henry Keen audits the forensic data behind the $1.08 billion bill and breaks down the Wall Street Journal's latest assessment on how deep strikes are crippling the Kremlin’s war economy.

recentItems.title: HELL ON THE FRONTLINE 244 CLASHES! Ukraine repels attacks as RUSSIA fabricates imaginary victories
recentItems.description:
One of the hottest and bloodiest days on the frontline: the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine recorded a record-breaking 244 combat engagements over the past 24 hours! The Russian command threw colossal resources and waves of infantry into the Pokrovsk direction, but Ukrainian defenders demonstrated iron resilience and repelled 39 fierce enemy attacks, inflicting devastating losses on the occupiers in both equipment and manpower!

With no real breakthroughs on the battlefield, Kremlin propaganda has once again resorted to its favorite tactic — mass dumping of fakes about alleged "capture" of Ukrainian towns and villages. Why Moscow feeds its domestic audience with illusory victories, how Putin's generals try to justify the failure of command plans, and what the real situation is on the hottest sections of the front — watch our detailed frontline review!
